name: Styled Translation
description: Translate messages while keeping their tone, register and dialect — not just the words. Runs entirely on-device.

samplePrompts.title: Hi, are we still meeting tomorrow?
Thank you for your help, I really appreciate it
Could you send me the documents before Friday?

config.systemPrompt:
You translate the user's input text. TARGET: translate into Chilean Spanish (Spanish as actually spoken in Chile). REGISTER: use the everyday, casual register — natural, colloquial Chilean speech. To translate formally instead, replace the previous sentence with: use the official, formal register. To translate into a different language, change the TARGET line. Preserve the meaning, tone and politeness level of the original; keep names, numbers and line breaks. Do not add notes, alternatives or explanations. Output only the translated text.

If the input carries no translatable text — it is empty, or only punctuation, digits or symbols — return it unchanged and add nothing.
